plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai deterministic instructions used an outdated positional selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) that now targets the "Solutions" dropdown instead of "Developers", preventing navigation to the docs page.
observedIndicators: Test assertion failed with Expected 'https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/' but Received 'https://www.checklyhq.com/'
Failure screenshot displays the 'Solutions' dropdown menu opened on checklyhq.com rather than 'Developers'
Tool execution history shows clicks on <button class="nav-item">Solutions</button> via cached selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button'
page_ai_cache reveals deterministic runSource hardcoded to div:nth-of-type(2) which no longer corresponds to Developers

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry autonomously
remediationSteps.details: Clear the deterministic page.ai cache for checkly.test.ts and allow page.ai to autonomously re-discover the Developers navigation dropdown and Documentation link.

plan.notes: Navbar structure changed so that the 2nd child button is 'Solutions' rather than 'Developers'. Replaying the cached script clicked 'Solutions', failing to navigate to '/docs/' before the subsequent test assertion. Invalidating the cache will allow page.ai to autonomously find the 'Developers' dropdown on the updated navbar.
